# WalletHub

> > WalletHub is a comprehensive personal finance platform offering credit card comparisons, loan matching, free credit scores, and financial wellness tools to help consumers make informed financial decisions.

WalletHub provides access to 1,500+ credit card offers from major issuers like Chase, Visa, American Express, Wells Fargo, and Bank of America. The platform features WalletScore credit monitoring powered by TransUnion, user reviews, budgeting tools, and personalized financial recommendations across credit cards, personal loans, and insurance products.

## Key Topics

- Credit Cards & Comparisons
- WalletScore & Credit Monitoring
- Personal Loans & Installment Loans
- TransUnion Credit Reports
- Chase Sapphire Preferred & Premium Cards
- Wells Fargo Active Cash Card
- Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover
- Financial Wellness & Budgeting Tools
- Debt Management Strategies
- Identity Protection Services
- User Reviews & Ratings
- Healthcare Financing (CareCredit)
- Investment Tracking
- Bank of America & Barclays Products
- John Kiernan (Editor/Analyst)
